name: Unearthed Power adds 6% damage and crit per Chromatic Shard stack (#1903)
contract: The Chromatic Shard stacking buff 503829 describes itself as "Reduces the cast time of Chromatic Shard by ${-$w1}%$?s503831[ and increases its damage and critical strike chance by $503831s1%][]. Stacks $u times." In Spell.dbc 503829 has StackAmount 10; its Effect[1] is SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER (108) EffectMiscValue 0 (SPELLMOD_DAMAGE) and its Effect[2] is SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER (107) EffectMiscValue 7 (SPELLMOD_CRITICAL_CHANCE), both EffectBasePoints -1 + DieSides 1 = 0 and both masked [0,4096,0], which inside SpellFamilyName 28 selects the castable Chromatic Shard ranks (501836-501840, 567543, 567544, 574346). Unearthed Power 503831 is two SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER effects, EffectMiscValue 12 (SPELLMOD_EFFECT2) and 23 (SPELLMOD_EFFECT3), EffectBasePoints 5 + DieSides 1 = +6 each, masked [64,0,0], which selects 503829. Unit::ApplyEffectModifiers routes SPELLMOD_EFFECT2/EFFECT3 to effect indexes 1 and 2, and AuraEffect::CalculateAmount ends with amount *= GetStackAmount(), so five stacks carry 30. Generic core machinery. This scenario is a regression guard for behaviour that already works. Anomaly Spikes is the buff's intended in-game stack source and never procs today (see #852), so the stacks are fixtured with set_aura to isolate this talent.
